title: Monthly exported report should show rent recovery percentage, not just raw collected/dues numbers
description: MonthlyReportViewModel already tracks totalCollected and totalDues, and the CSV export (buildReportCsv in MonthlyReportScreen.kt) already includes both as separate rows - but there's no computed recovery percentage (collected / expected billed for the period), which is the number a warden actually wants when reconciling a month, not two raw totals they have to do the division on themselves. Depends on LODGY-100 settling what 'expected income' means for the month (total billed vs. total collected + outstanding) since recovery % needs that denominator to be unambiguous.
acceptanceCriteria: The exported monthly report (CSV, buildReportCsv) includes a recovery percentage row, computed the same way as wherever LODGY-100 lands on 'expected income' for consistency
Recovery percentage is also shown on the Monthly Report screen itself, not just in the export
Handles a month with zero expected income (e.g. no active tenancies yet) without a divide-by-zero or a misleading 0%/100%

history.note: "this recovery info should also be shown in monthly exported report." Follows from LODGY-100 (recovery % on the overview screen) - the same figure belongs in the export too. Confirmed buildReportCsv already has totalCollected/totalDues rows but no recovery percentage.
